name: Consumed
body:
CONSUMED
CR 9

As the jumble of putrefied blood, bits of flesh, and broken bones roils across the ground, those nearby fight a wave of nausea.

XP 6,400
N Medium aberration
Init +2; Senses darkvision 60 ft., scent; Perception +23 Aura revulsion (DC 21 3 rounds)

DEFENSE

AC 20, touch 12, flat-footed 18 (+2 Dex, +8 natural)
hp 133 (14d8+56)
Fort +9, Ref +5, Will +6; DR 5/-; Immune acid, critical hits, exhaustion, fatigue, nauseated, poison, polymorph, precision damage, sickened

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee 2 slams +12 (1d6+2 plus digestive juices)
Space 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft.

STATISTICS

Str 22, Dex 14, Con 18, Int 6, Wis 11, Cha 5
Base Atk +6; CMB +12; CMD 24 (28 vs trip)
Feats Blood Feast, Great Fortitude, Improved Natural Attack, Skill Focus (Perception), Toughness
Skills Escape Artist 19, Perception +23
SQ digestive juices, unidentifiable anatomy
Languages understands Common, but can’t speak

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Digestive Juices (Ex)

When a consumed makes a successful melee attack against a creature, the wound is bathed in acidic digestive fluids. The creature must make a DC 21 Fortitude save. The creature takes 4d6 acid damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful save. The save DC is Constitution-based.

Revulsion (Ex)

All living creatures within 30 feet of a consumed must make a Fortitude save DC 21. A creature is nauseated for three rounds on a failed save or sickened for 1 round on a successful save.

Whether or not a creature succeeds or fails on its saving throw, it can’t be affected again by the revulsion aura of the same consumed for 24 hours.

Delay poison or neutralize poison removes the effect from the affected creature. Creatures with immunity to poison are immune to this aura. The save DC is Constitution-based.

Unidentifiable Anatomy (Ex)

The organs of a consumed are randomly arranged and difficult to differentiate amongst the gore. This grants the creature immunity to precision damage and critical hits.

ECOLOGY

Environment any wilderness
Organization solitary
Treasure standard (undigested held or worn items of victims in the stomach of the consumed)

The threat of being eaten alive by a wild beast can lead a person to an act of desperation. An insane and particularly perverted entity from beyond the Void lurks in remote wilderness locations, waiting to take advantage of just such a situation. When the soon-to-be-eaten individual is at their most vulnerable, the demented being offers the terrified creature a bargain—an escape from death—but at a horrible price!

Though the threatened creature is spared from death, it is transformed into a consumed. A consumed is an unrecognizable mass of torn flesh and broken body parts that must undulate along the ground rather than walk upright. The consumed loses its ability to speak and is cursed with an unquenchable hunger. For the rest of its days, the consumed roams the wilderness seeking to abate its accursed hunger with whatever unfortunate creature crosses its path.

Into the Wilds: Consumed, © 2024, Bloodstone Press; Designer Beth Jones
